# The hub directory may hold hand-written Go files, a type and a go:generate
# line among them. muxt generate writes route_paths.go and leaves them alone,
# every time it runs.

muxt generate
exists route_paths.go
muxt check
exec go build ./...
cmp types.go types.go.orig
cmp generate.go generate.go.orig

muxt generate
cmp types.go types.go.orig
cmp generate.go generate.go.orig
exec go build ./...

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
  "route_paths": {},
  "package_defaults": {
    "use_receiver_type": "Server"
  },
  "packages": {
    "example.com/m/admin": [
      {}
    ],
    "example.com/m/blog": [
      {}
    ]
  }
}
-- types.go --
package m

// Shared is declared by hand in the hub.
type Shared struct{ Name string }
-- types.go.orig --
package m

// Shared is declared by hand in the hub.
type Shared struct{ Name string }
-- generate.go --
package m

//go:generate muxt generate
-- generate.go.orig --
package m

//go:generate muxt generate
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Dashboard() []int { return []int{42} }
-- admin/dashboard.gohtml --
{{define "GET /admin Dashboard()"}}{{range .Result}}<a href="{{$.Path.Blog.GetArticle .}}">article</a>{{end}}{{end}}
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }
-- blog/article.gohtml --
{{define "GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)"}}<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>{{end}}
